phase2_deploy_built.title: AI Product Description Writing
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is specifically right for Baukjen now because it can help improve product descriptions, which are crucial for AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation, and Baukjen has a staff digital literacy score of 5.55, indicating a good foundation to build on.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen, start by integrating the API with your existing Shopify store. Then, train the AI model on your brand's specific voice and tone by providing a sample dataset of existing product descriptions. Finally, use the API to generate first-draft product descriptions, which can then be lightly edited by human staff before publishing.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.

next_steps: Integrate Claude API with your Shopify store using the API's provided documentation and support resources.
Train the AI model on your brand's specific voice and tone by providing a sample dataset of existing product descriptions.
Use the API to generate first-draft product descriptions for a small batch of products, and have human staff review and edit the output before publishing.

market_tools_recommended.why_this_business: Claude's AI writing assistant is well-suited to crafting nuanced, brand-voice-consistent fashion copy, which is crucial for Baukjen's high-end, sustainable fashion brand.

Jasper's marketing-focused AI writing tool offers fashion/retail content templates that could help Baukjen streamline their product description writing process and emphasize sustainability credentials.

While ChatGPT's general-purpose AI writing capabilities could be useful for drafting product copy, its lack of Shopify integration and higher estimated cost (£800-£1600) make it a less appealing option for Baukjen.
